apps.name: BYD Sea Lion 06
apps.localizedDescription: Компаньйон для BYD Sea Lion 06: стан авто, клімат, сидіння, камери.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Fixed
- **Remote commands no longer run twice after a restart.** When the service was started twice within milliseconds
  (BootReceiver and BootAnchor after an update), the first MQTT link finished connecting after it had been superseded
  and stayed subscribed, so every command from the phone or HA was handled twice (seen with the child lock on
  2026-11-14). A superseded loop now always closes its own link, and closing waits for a connect in progress.
- **Drives are recorded again.** In D this car reports power level ON (2), not OK (3), so drives were filed inside
  parkings. A drive now starts at ON with a drive gear; ON in P before any gear (the car waking up when the driver's
  door opens) still counts as parked (`openspec/changes/trip-history-publishing/` 3.3).
- **A spoofed GPS position while parked no longer ends up in the next drive's route.** On 2026-11-14 a fix in Lima,
  Peru at ~202 km/h was accepted while the car stood in P (the recorder reads no CAN speed when not driving), and the
  morning drive's track sat in Peru for an hour. In P the recorder now expects 0 km/h, and the published route leaves
  out points flagged as spoofed (`openspec/changes/trip-recording-real-drive-fixes/`).

### Added
- **The Маршрути map zooms** in the companion apps and the HA card: pinch, the mouse wheel in a browser, and «+» / «−»
  buttons above «До авто», which also resets the zoom (`openspec/changes/routes-map-zoom/`).
- **Trip details in the companion apps and the HA card.** On Маршрути a record's text now wraps instead of being cut,
  and a double tap opens a dialog with every value of the record: duration, distance, odometer, average and top speed, energy,
  average use, energy from the pack, regeneration, SOC with its change and the outside temperature (charging: type,
  energy and peak power). A single tap still shows the record's route alone on the map
  (`openspec/changes/trip-details-dialog/`).
- **Dark theme in the companion apps and the Home Assistant card.** The phones (Android, iOS) follow the system
  theme and the card follows Home Assistant's dark mode; the light theme is unchanged. Dark colours sit beside the light
  ones in the shared core, the map is shown dark, and Figma has a matching `Dark` mode
  (`openspec/changes/companion-dark-theme/`).
- **Head unit learns this car's energy use per kilometre.** While driving, every kilometre's net pack energy (V × I,
  regeneration negative; the `lifetime_kwh` counter as a fallback) is filed into a matrix by speed band, exterior
  temperature band, climate (off / fan / heating / cooling), seat or steering heating, drive mode (`unknown` until its
  signal is found) and season. Kept on the head unit in `files/consumption/` (`matrix.json` and one line per km in
  `km-YYYY-MM.jsonl`). Nothing is shown yet: the range forecast in both UIs comes next
  (`openspec/changes/range-from-consumption-matrix/`).
